# Schmidt et al. 2025 reduced spectra

Source: Zenodo [10.5281/zenodo.14735689](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14735689) (CC-BY-4.0), supplement to
Schmidt et al., "A Comprehensive Reanalysis of K2-18 b's JWST NIRISS+NIRSpec Transmission Spectrum" ([arXiv:2501.18477](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.18477), AJ 170, 298).
Only the R100/R200 `.dat` spectra were extracted (zip is 448 MB). Columns: wavelength (um), bin half-width, depth (fraction), uncertainty. Reductions: Eureka! (A=Ahrer, B=Bell), FIREFLy, exoTEDRF.
